name: Argonne High School Autonomous Vehicle Competition
what_you_do: Your school team designs and programs a self-driving model car to get through a maze in the least time with the least help. You write a proposal, keep records, and present your work.
who_can_apply: Teams of 4 to 6 high school students from the same school. The coach must be a teacher or administrator there. One team per school. Teams get in first come, first served.
pay_detail: The page does not say if there is a cost.
duration: Winter to April, ending with a one-day event
deadline_text: 2026 team sign-up closed Jan 9, 2026, with the event in April. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to coach a team and register it on the competition page. Read the handbook for that year's task.
notes: The task and theme change every year. Teams are judged on their design process, the car and how it runs. Spots fill first come, first served, so ask a teacher in the fall.
